# Vendored Ryu double formatter

The files in this directory are from the `ryu/` directory of
[ulfjack/ryu](https://github.com/ulfjack/ryu), upstream commit
`4c0618b0e44f7ef027ebae05d2cc7812048f7c8f`.

The upstream project explicitly permits files in `ryu/` to be used under the
Boost Software License 1.0. The license text and original copyright notices
are retained here. BMEC embeds the double conversion source and required lookup
tables into generated C so native executables remain standalone.
